title: Factor risk and desk contributions
prompt: Desk losses are linear in two zero-mean unit-scale factors. Rows of the loading matrix are desksA,B,C in USD million per factor unit. Factor covariance is supplied; there is no residual risk. For the fixed book, return total volatility, Euler volatility contributions by desk (derivative of volatility with respect to a multiplicative desk weight, evaluated at weights1), the first factor's Euler share of total variance, and the change in volatility from removing deskC entirely. Do not optimize weights.

outputs.name: factor1_variance_share
outputs.description: First aggregate loading times its covariance with total loss, divided by total variance.
